{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate average revenue per customer in each channel, stratified by customer_segment
# This adjusts for the imbalance in customer segment
revenue_per_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute weighted average revenue per channel, weighted by segment size
channel_size = sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].size().reset_index(name='count')

# Merge to get weights
revenue_per_segment = revenue_per_segment.merge(channel_size, on='channel')

# Compute weighted average revenue per channel
revenue_per_segment['weighted_revenue'] = revenue_per_segment['revenue'] * revenue_per_segment['count']
weighted_avg_revenue = revenue_per_segment.groupby('channel')['weighted_revenue'].sum() / channel_size.set_index('channel')['count']

# Final comparison
weighted_avg_revenue, channel_revenue"}
